narration_fil: Ang training manikin ay adult na hindi tumutugon at hindi normal ang paghinga. May AED trainer sa tabi.
narration_en: A training manikin represents an adult who is unresponsive and not breathing normally. An AED trainer is nearby.

display_fil:

Sundin ang kasalukuyang adult BLS sequence ng trainer
Sanayin ang compressions at AED prompts sa aprubadong kagamitan
Ihiwalay ang algorithm sa bata at pagkalunod bago ang mga iyon
display_en:
Activate help and request an AED
Follow the current adult BLS sequence from a qualified trainer
Practise compressions and AED prompts on approved equipment
Distinguish child and drowning pathways before those cases
narration_fil: Humingi ng tulong at AED. Sundin ang kasalukuyang adult BLS algorithm na ipinakita ng kwalipikadong trainer. Sanayin ang compressions at AED prompts sa aprubadong kagamitan. Bago ang kaso ng bata o sa tubig, ihiwalay ang algorithm para sa bata at sa pagkalunod.
narration_en: Activate help and request an AED. Follow the current adult BLS algorithm demonstrated by a qualified trainer. Practise compressions and AED prompts on approved equipment; distinguish the pediatric algorithm and drowning response before any child or water case.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi tumutugon at hindi normal ang paghinga ng manikin. Ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: The manikin does not respond and is not breathing normally. What do you do first?

options.fil: Kapain muna ang pulso bago magpasyang tumawag.
options.en: Check the pulse first, then decide whether to call.

options.fil: Tumawag ng tulong at humingi ng AED.
options.en: Call for help and ask for the AED.

options.fil: Simulan ang lumang CAB na hakbang mula sa manual.
options.en: Start the old CAB steps printed in the manual.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi dapat pulso lamang ang batayan kung hindi sanay. Tumawag muna ng tulong at AED. 2: Tama. Humingi muna ng tulong at AED bago hawakan ang manikin; saka sundin ang sequence ng trainer. 3: Hindi sertipikasyon ang lumang CAB talata. Sundin ang kasalukuyang sequence na ipinakita ng trainer.
check.feedback_en: 1: A pulse check should not be the only gate for an untrained rescuer. Call for help and the AED first. 2: Correct. Help and the AED are requested before hands touch the manikin; then follow the trainer's sequence. 3: The old CAB paragraph is not certification. Follow the current sequence the qualified trainer demonstrates.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Inuutusan ni Lea ang kapareha: tulong, lokasyon, AED
Ginagawa niya ito bago hawakan ang manikin
Saka niya sinusunod ang adult sequence ng trainer
Hindi pulso lamang, hindi ang lumang CAB talata
display_en:
Lea sends a partner for help, location and the AED
She does this before touching the manikin
Then she follows the trainer's adult sequence
No pulse-only gate, no old CAB paragraph
narration_fil: Si Lea ang unang nasa manikin station. Bago hawakan ang manikin, inuutusan niya ang kapareha na tumawag ng tulong, sabihin ang lokasyon at kunin ang AED. Pagkatapos, sinusunod niya ang kasalukuyang adult sequence na ipinakita ng trainer. Itinatala ng tagamasid ang bawat kilos. Hindi siya umaasa lamang sa pulso at hindi niya ginagamit ang lumang CAB talata.
narration_en: Lea is first at the manikin station. Before touching the manikin, she tells a partner to call for help, give the location and bring the AED. She then follows the current adult sequence the trainer demonstrated, while the observer records each action. She does not use a pulse check as her only gate or recite the old CAB paragraph.

display_fil:
Huwag umasa lamang sa pulso kung hindi sanay
Huwag mag-compression sa totoong tao
Hindi sertipikasyon ang lumang CAB talata
display_en:
No pulse check as the only gate for an untrained rescuer
No compressions on a live person
The old CAB paragraph is not certification
narration_fil: Huwag umasa lamang sa pulso kung hindi sanay. Huwag mag-compression sa totoong tao. Hindi sertipikasyon ang lumang CAB talata.
narration_en: Do not use a pulse check as the only gate for an untrained rescuer, practise compressions on a live person, or treat the old CAB paragraph as certification.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Nag-alok ang kaklase na humiga para sa kanya ka magsanay ng compression. Ano ang sasabihin mo?
check.prompt_en: A classmate offers to lie down so you can practise compressions on him. What do you say?

options.fil: Sige, mas makatotohanan ang totoong tao kaysa manikin.
options.en: Yes, a live partner feels more realistic than a manikin.

options.fil: Laktawan ang station; sapat nang basahin ang hakbang.
options.en: Skip the station; reading the steps is enough.

options.fil: Hindi, sa manikin lamang sinasanay ang compression.
options.en: No, compressions are practised only on the manikin.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi nagko-compression sa totoong tao. Gamitin ang aprubadong manikin. 2: Hindi sertipikasyon ang pagbasa ng lumang CAB talata; sinasanay ito kasama ang kwalipikadong trainer. 3: Tama. Sinasanay ang compression at AED prompts sa aprubadong kagamitan habang nanonood ang trainer.
check.feedback_en: 1: Compressions are not practised on a live person. Use the approved manikin. 2: Reading the old CAB paragraph is not certification; the skill is practised with a qualified trainer. 3: Correct. Compressions and AED prompts are practised on approved equipment with the trainer watching.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, gamitin ang kaparehong checklist sa bagong kathang-isip na kaso. Itala ang nakita at kung sino ang tatawagan. Sa supervised manikin, ipakita ang pagtawag, paghingi ng AED at aprubadong adult sequence; itala ang naobserbahan.
narration_en: On Monday, use the same checklist with a new fictional case. Record observations and the confirmed contact. At a supervised manikin station, show help activation, AED request and the trainer-approved adult sequence; record each observed action.
